// Only fully successful cells go into the cache; failures are retried on the next run
return $input.all().map(i => i.json).filter(r => r.archive && r.archive.ok && r.climate && r.climate.ok).map(r => ({ json: {
  cell_key: r.cell_key,
  cell_lat: r.lat,
  cell_lon: r.lon,
  config_signature: r.config_signature,
  archive_hash: r.archive.hash,
  climate_hash: r.climate.hash,
  archive_url: r.archive_url,
  climate_url: r.climate_url,
  archive_metrics_json: JSON.stringify(r.archive),
  climate_metrics_json: JSON.stringify(r.climate),
  fetched_at: new Date().toISOString(),
} }));

messageValues.message: You explain pipeline corridor climate risk to field engineers. Output exactly two plain-language sentences and nothing else. Cite the exact numbers you are given (percent changes, NDVI drop, slope, score). Name the biggest drivers first. Do not invent numbers, causes, locations, or recommendations that are not supported by the metrics. No headings, lists, or markdown.

parameters.content:
## NGTL · W2 Long-range geohazard engine
Scores every kilometre of corridor ngtl-ab-osm (the 505 km of NGTL that OpenStreetMap names, 508 rows) 0 to 100 for ground, crossings, wildfire weather and drought for 2026 to 2030 and 2031 to 2035. Gemini explains amber and red segments only; the score itself is plain code.

**Trigger:** Called by NGTL · W1, and weekly
**Reads:** ngtl_segments, ngtl_baselines (previous run, crossings), ngtl_climate_cells cache, Sentinel-2 NDVI (Copernicus), elevation (Open-Meteo)
**Writes:** ngtl_baselines, ngtl_predictions, ngtl_sources. Never the corridor_* tables.
**Next:** Feeds NGTL · WF3 and NGTL · API - Dashboard feed

**Climate comes only from the cache, on a 0.5° grid** (grid_cell_deg = 0.5; Edmonton stays 0.1). Open-Meteo blocks n8n Cloud, so max_cell_fetches_per_run = 0. NGTL needs 9 cells at 0.5° (data/ngtl/cells.json); as of Nov 23 ngtl_climate_cells holds 4 of them (54.50_-113.00, 55.00_-112.50, 55.00_-113.50, 55.50_-112.50) plus 4 leftover 0.1° cells from the first attempt, which W2 does not use. A segment whose cell has no current (v3) row is unverified. To add cells: node scripts/fetch-climate-cells.js --corridor ngtl-ab-osm, node scripts/make-seed-workflow.js --corridor ngtl-ab-osm, then re-import and run NGTL Seed - Hazard inputs.

**NDVI and elevation are fetched once per segment.** Needs live NDVI / Needs live elevation send only segments with no usable cached series or elevations on their ngtl_baselines row; Align NDVI / Align elevation put the answers back in segment order by segment_id. The NDVI window is fixed (2021 to 2025), so a good series does not go stale. If nothing is missing, one segment is still sent so the run continues.

Source of truth: github.com/katiescase/terracorridor, workflows/ngtl/NGTL · W2 - Long-Range Engine.json (patch: scripts/ngtl-w2-cache.js). Change the repo and re-import, do not hand-edit.
